description: This header file defines the WPEFramework::Plugin::Grpc::Store2 class, which implements the IStore2 interface for gRPC-based secure storage communication. It includes class definitions, private helper functions, and external dependencies for secure storage management over gRPC, with functionality for setting, getting, deleting keys, and managing notifications.
